Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! The umpires and players have made their way out in the middle. Rashada Williams and Britney Cooper are out in the middle to open for West Indies Women. Shikha Pandey will start the proceedings for India Women with the ball. Here we go..
... The Run Chase ...

Shanika Bruce and Karishma Ramharack were the only wicket-takers for the West Indies Women. Their new ball bowlers Bruce and Shamilia Connell were tidy and did not give too many freebies but Connell did go for a bit of a tap in her final over. The support bowlers had a poor outing and the experienced Indian duo took them to the cleaners. West Indies Women now have the daunting task of chasing 168 against the Indian spinners. It will be a difficult ask for them and they will look at skipper Hayley Matthews to come out all guns blazing. Stay tuned as we shall be back with the West Indies Women's reply shortly.

A 115-run partnership off just 70 balls between Smriti Mandhana and Harmanpreet Kaur has taken India Women to 167 for 2 in their 20 overs. 64 runs came in the final five overs and it was total carnage by the Indian batters. India started off slowly. West Indies Women bowled tight lines and kept the pressure on the Indian batters. They were assisted by some good fielding too. India were reduced to 60 for 2 at the halfway mark. Kaur and Mandhana got going after that and took a liking to the bowlers. Rashada Williams spilled a few chances behind the stumps and Kaur made them pay for it. Mandhana batted through the innings and ended with 74* off 51 and Kaur in her comeback game notched up an unbeaten 56 off just 35 balls.

FOUR! Harmanpreet Kaur ends the innings in style! This is tossed up outside off, Kaur comes down the track and flat-bats it into the wide long off fence for a boundary. India Women finish with a big score of 167/2 on the board!
This is pushed through quicker on off stump, Smriti Mandhana plays it through covers for one.

FIFTY for the skipper Harmanpreet Kaur and what a quality knock this has been, a total game-changer. This is full and on leg stump, Kaur paddles it 'round the corner toward fine leg and picks up three runs.
Flatter delivery around off, Smriti Mandhana slaps it toward deep cover for one more.
Holds it back a touch and floats it outside off, Harmanpreet Kaur tries to drag the sweep shot but gets an inside edge off the pads. The ball rolls on the off side and they get a run.
This is flighted, on a length and Harmanpreet Kaur drags the sweep shot to deep mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Floated up outside off, Kaur pushes it down to long off for a single.
On the shorter side and on middle and leg, Smriti Mandhana advances and slogs it through square leg for a single.
SIX! All the way! Tossed up on off stump, Smriti Mandhana skips down the track and gets to the pitch of the ball before smoking it over long off for a biggie.
DROPPED! This is short and wide from Afy Fletcher. Harmanpreet Kaur rocks back and cuts it hard and uppishly toward point where the fielder spills the catch and they also get the single.
Flighted delivery around off, Harmanpreet Kaur shuffles across and looks for the slog but misses.
WIDE! This is pushed a long way outside the off stump and it is left alone for a wide.
Smriti Mandhana looks to charge down the track but Afy Fletcher drags the length back. Mandhana tucks it leg side for a quick single.
Hard length on off stump, Mandhana looks to pull but gets an inside edge toward square leg. They scamper through for the single.

FOUR! Oh my, the fielder in the deep is completely undone by the spin. This is banged in short and around leg stump. Smriti Mandhana pulls it toward deep backward square leg and gets yet another boundary.

FOUR! Streaky but effective! A slower one, dropping on the batter outside off. Smriti Mandhana throws her hand at it but ends up slicing it off the outside edge. The fielder at short third man is beating to her right and the ball trickles away into the fence.
A loopy full toss outside off and dropping on the batter, Kaur reaches out and eases it through mid off for a run.
FOUR! Two in a row! Just a fraction shorter on off stump, Harmanpreet Kaur shuffles across and pulls it hard and through mid-wicket for another boundary.
FOUR! Wow, that has been thumped! This is full and around off, Harmanpreet Kaur stays deep in her crease and holds her shape to hammer it over mid off for a boundary.
Shamilia Connell (3-0-10-0) is back on.
Nicely flighted around middle and turning into the left-hander. Smriti Mandhana misses the slog-sweep and gets hit on the pads. There is half an appeal for lbw but it is turned down.
A full toss on middle, this is hammered along the ground and toward long on for a single.
Kaysia Schultz gets away with that one. A full toss now down the leg side, Harmanpreet Kaur paddles it 'round the corner but the fielder at short fine leg makes a sharp stop to her right.
FOUR! Floated full and down leg, Harmanpreet Kaur plays the paddle sweep this time and hammers it into the fine leg fence.
Flatter one around off, this is nudged away toward backward point.

FOUR! Good improvisation from Harmanpreet Kaur and the boundaries just keep on flowing. Kaur pre-meditates and gets down on one for the sweep but the ball is a bit shorter. Kaur adjusts and helps it over backward square leg for a boundary.
A dot to end but 14 runs come off it! Length ball, on a tighter line around off stump, Mandhana eases it toward point.
FOUR! The third boundary in the over and Smriti Mandhana is having a ball out there. Fullish length down leg, Mandhana flicks it past short fine leg for a boundary.
Good length on off, pushed toward mid off.
FOUR! FIFTY for Smriti Mandhana and India Women are on a roll here. This is a shorter ball around off, Mandhana just lifts it off the back foot and over covers for yet another boundary.
FOUR! Easy pickings! This is bowled from around the wicket and angled in on the pads at a shorter length. Smriti Mandhana pulls it off her hips and into the backward square leg fence for a boundary.
On a good length and on off stump, Smriti Mandhana looks to loft it over mid-wicket but chips it over wide mid on for a couple of runs.
FOUR! Flighted on the stumps, Harmanpreet Kaur gets inside the line and sweeps it over the vacant backward square leg region for a boundary.
Length and around off, Harmanpreet Kaur misses out on the slog sweep, a huge appeal from Afy Fletcher and is turned down by the umpire.
Fuller on the stumps, Smriti Mandhana sweeps it to deep square leg for one.
FOUR!! Full and outside off, Smriti Mandhana waits and squeezes it through the point region as the ball races to the fence for four.
Short and outside off, Harmanpreet Kaur pulls it hard to deep backward square leg for one.
Full and outside off, Smriti Mandhana uses her feet and lofts it down to long off for one.
Afy Fletcher (2-0-11-0) is back on.
Full and on the stumps, Harmanpreet Kaur smears it to Hayley Matthews at mid on.
Slower one outside the tramline, Wide called.
Slower one outside off, Harmanpreet Kaur drives it to the cover fielder.
EDGED and DROPPED! Length ball outside off, Harmanpreet Kaur goes for the cut and edges it to the keeper who puts it down. A life for Harmanpreet Kaur here.
Short of a length on the stumps, Smriti Mandhana shimmies down and pulls it through deep square leg for one.
Full and outside off, Harmanpreet Kaur drives it to covers for one. The fielder does well to stop and saves 3.
Shabika Gajnabi bowls a full and on the stumps, Smriti Mandhana heaves it to deep mid-wicket for one.
Shabika Gajnabi comes into the attack now.
Short and outside off, Harmanpreet Kaur dabs it fine past the short third fielder down to third man region for a couple.
Full and outside off, Smriti Mandhana drives it nicely to long off for one.
Length ball on off, Smriti Mandhana rocks back and bunts it to covers.
Short on off, Harmanpreet Kaur pulls it down to long on for one.
Tad short on the stumps, Smriti Mandhana shimmies down and pulls it to square leg for one.
FOUR! Kaysia Schultz dishes out a full ball outside off, and Smriti Mandhana comes down the track and lofts it over the extra cover region for a boundary. Good batting by Smriti Mandhana.
Kaysia Schultz to have a bowl now.
Slower ball outside off, Smriti Mandhana leaves it alone and a fumble by Rashada Williams behind the stumps allows the batter to run a bye.
Short of a length angled into the batter, Smriti Mandhana pulls and misses.
FOUR!! BANG! Full and in the slot. Smriti Mandhana makes room and lofts it down the ground to the long on region as the ball goes one bounce for four.
Length ball angling into the batter, Smriti Mandhana bunts it back to the bowler.
Length ball outside off, Harmanpreet Kaur drops it to the off side and the batters scamper for a quick single.
Short of a length on the stumps, Smriti Mandhana pulls it to deep mid-wicket for one.
FOUR!! Short and wide outside off, Harmanpreet Kaur waits and guides it nicely to the third man region for a delicate boundary. Excellent shot.
Tossed up outside off, Harmanpreet Kaur goes for the drive and misses.
Short and outside off, Smriti Mandhana punches it off her back foot through covers for one.
Length ball outside off, Smriti Mandhana waits and cuts it to point.
Full on off, Harmanpreet Kaur tickles it away to the fine leg region. The fielder Shemaine Campbelle runs around and saves one for her side.
FOUR!! Hayley Matthews bowls a short ball outside off, and Harmanpreet Kaur guides it past the backward point fielder as the ball races to the fence for four.

DRINKS. The West Indies Women have done well to keep India Women at 6 runs per over at the halfway mark. Harmanpreet Kaur and Smriti Mandhana will look to bat deep and take India Women to a competitive total. West Indies Women have been electric in the field thus far and have saved crucial runs. An enticing phase of play awaits.
Missed opportunity! A half-tracker on middle, Harmanpreet Kaur goes hard at the pull but mistimes it badly down to long on for one.
A tad short and wide, Kaur cuts it nicely through point. The fielder at deep cover runs around to her left and makes a good diving stop. They pick up a brace.
Flatter trajectory, turning away from around off stump, Harmanpreet Kaur looks to cut it late but misses.
Smriti Mandhana gives charge and Afy Fletcher just fires it in full on off stump. Mandhana flicks it off the inner half of the bat through mid-wicket for one more.
Brilliant work in the deep. Tossed up around middle, Harmanpreet Kaur connects with the slog-sweep firmly and the fielder at deep mid-wicket makes a sharp stop to her right. Just the single then.
This is dragged down a bit on off stump, Smriti Mandhana pulls it off the back foot in front of mid-wicket for a single.
A low full toss now around off, Smriti Mandhana pushes it through mid off and collects a single.
Nicely bowled! Shanika Bruce just floats this one up full and in that channel around off. The ball angles across and as Smriti Mandhana looks for the drive, she gets beaten past the outside edge.
Risky single but Harmanpreet Kaur gets off the mark. Length again around middle, Kaur tucks it toward short mid-wicket and scampers through for one.
Good length outside off, Harmanpreet Kaur stays back and looks to run it fine but gets beaten on the outside edge.
India Women skipper Harmanpreet Kaur is the new batter at number 4.

OUT! LBW! Shanika Bruce gets the crucial breakthrough for West Indies Women. Bruce bowls it on a length and on off stump. Harleen Deol looks to flick but the ball just nips away a touch and ends up playing all over it. The ball pings her on the back leg and after a loud appeal, the finger is eventually raised.
WIDE! Fuller and angled down the leg side, Deol misses the flick and a wide is called.
FOUR! Short and punished! This is outside off, Harleen Deol rocks back and cuts it past a diving fielder at backward point for a boundary.
On a length and turning away from around off, Harleen Deol plays it square on the off side for one more.
This is dragged down on middle and leg, Smriti Mandhana pulls it behind square leg and picks up a single.

Excellent work in the deep! Another juicy full toss around off, Smriti Mandhana drives it gently through extra cover. The fielder from long off runs to her right and pulls it back in. They get two runs.
Afy Fletcher sees Harleen Deol advancing and bowls it short and way outside the off stump. Deol manages to reach it and plays it toward cover for a quick single.
A tad shorter and outside off, Deol taps it straight to cover.
Starts off with a flatter delivery outside off and this one turns away from the right-hander. Harleen Deol leaves it alone.
A friendly full toss but Harleen Deol can't get it through. This is outside off, Deol strokes it wide of mid off for only a single.
This is fuller and around off, Harleen Deol drives it well but straight toward extra cover.
WIDE! A length ball, pushed well outside the off stump, left alone for a wide.
Good fielding! Shorter and outside off, Smriti Mandhana rocks back and taps it in front of cover-point. The fielder there makes a good half-stop and keeps it down to a run.
Pitched up around off, this is punched through mid off for a run.
This is very full and outside off, Harleen Deol looks to drive it square but gets beaten.
Fuller and on leg stump, Smriti Mandhana backs away and pushes it down to long off for a single.
FOUR!! SHOT! Tossed up outside off, Harleen Deol leans and drives it through the covers as the ball races away to the fence for four. Good start by Harleen Deol.
Harleen Deol is the new batter in at number 3.

GONE!! CAUGHT! Tossed up outside off, Yastika Bhatia reaches for the drive and the ball spins away, takes the outside edge and the keeper does the rest. Yastika Bhatia departs for 18 as India Women lose their first.
Commentary.Howout: c Rashada Williams b Karishma Ramharack

Commentary.Commentary: Angled on the stumps, Yastika Bhatia shimmies down and pushes it back to the bowler.
FOUR MORE! Full and on the stumps. Yastika Bhatia uses her feet and drives it past the bowler down the ground for another boundary.
FOUR! BANG! Yastika Bhatia takes it on the full and smacks it to the deep mid-wicket region for a boundary. Excellent hit.
Starts off with a full ball outside off, Yastika Bhatia defends it on the off-side.
FOUR! Smriti Mandhana hangs back and cuts the short delivery in the gap between the cover and backward point for a boundary.
Flatter delivery outside off, Smriti Mandhana punches it off the backfoot through cover-point and comes back for the second.
Short and turning away, Smriti Mandhana hangs back and cuts it to point.
Short again outside off, Smriti Mandhana guides it to point.
Length and outside off, Yastika Bhatia dabs it to point.
Floats outside off, Smriti Mandhana drives it through covers for a single.
Windies Skipper Hayley Matthews comes into the attack.
Tad short and outside off, Yastika Bhatia looks to cut and misses. An appeal from behind the stumps but the umpire is not interested.
Full and shaping away outside off, Yastika Bhatia gets beaten on the drive.
Length and shaping away outside off, Yastika Bhatia pokes at it and is beaten.
Full and outside off, Yastika Bhatia advances for the drive and misses.
Full and around off, Smriti Mandhana drives it through covers for one.
Full and way outside off, wide again.
Full and angling outside the tramline. Wide signaled.
Yorker outside off, Smriti Mandhana leaves it alone.
Full and outside off, Yastika Bhatia squeezes the drive to mid-off.
FOUR! Poor ball down the leg, Yastika Bhatia helps her way down the leg for a boundary, Easy pickings.
Yastika Bhatia shimmies down and takes it on the full, swings across the line and gets a top edge as the ball flies over short fine and allows the batter to take 2.
Good length ball outside off, Smriti Mandhana angles it to backward point and a fumble allows the batter to take one.
Yorker on the stumps. Yastika Bhatia digs it out and works it to mid-wicket for one.
A low full toss around off, Yastika Bhatia mistimes the drive back to the bowler.
Shorter in length outside off, Yastika Bhatia cuts, and a misfield from the fielder at point allows the batters to take a run.
Fuller delivery outside off, Yastika Bhatia drives at it away from her body only to get beaten on the outside edge.
Shaping in on the stumps, Yastika Bhatia pushes it straight to mid-on. No run.
Good length delivery in the channel outside off, Bhatia defends at it and gets beaten on the outside edge.
Length and outside off, Yastika Bhatia mistimes the pull to mid off.
Back of a length delivery on off. Yastika Bhatia defends it back to the bowler.
Shamilia Connell to bowl from the other end.
FOUR! Short from Bruce down the leg, Smriti Mandhana swivels and pulls it aerially behind square on the leg side for a boundary.
Short of a length this time outside off, Smriti Mandhana cuts it to point.
Good length ball on the pads, Smriti Mandhana works it to mid-wicket.
Back of a length around off, Smriti Mandhana plays it back to the bowler.
Fuller delivery on the stumps with a hint of shape, Smriti Mandhana defends it straight.
Shanika Bruce starts off with a length ball outside off, and Yastika Bhatia steers it to the third man for one.

Done with the pre-game formalities and it is now time for the play to begin. The two umpires are out in the middle and the players of West Indies Women too make their way out to the middle after a huddle. Smriti Mandhana and Yastika Bhatia will open the innings for India Women. Shanika Bruce has the new ball in hand and is raring to go. Let's play...

We are almost ready for the start of the play! But first, the two sets of players will line up for their respective national anthems. It will be Wes Indies' national anthem first followed by the national anthem of India.

Deepti Sharma, the star of the first game is up for a quick chat. says that they did really well and it was good to give an all-round performance. Adds that the players have recovered well after the first game and they will have them back today. Says that this is a good practice for them to assess the conditions before the T20 World Cup.

West Indies Women (Playing XI) - Hayley Matthews (C), Rashada Williams (WK) Shanika Bruce (In for Shakera Selman), Shemaine Campbelle, Shamilia Connell, Britney Cooper, Afy Fletcher, Shabika Gajnabi, Karishma Ramharack, Chedean Nation and Kaysia Schult.

India Women (Playing XI) - Smriti Mandhana, Yastika Bhatia (WK), Harmanpreet Kaur (In for Sneh Rana) (C), Harleen Deol, Jemimah Rodrigues, Devika Vaidya, Deepti Sharma, Amanjot Kaur, Radha Yadav, Shikha Pandey (In for Anjali Sarvani) and Rajeshwari Gayakwad.
TOSS - India Women have won the toss and they will BAT first.

The Windies Women, on the other end, lost by a huge margin of 44 runs in their first game against SA Women. Their bowlers did the job and kept South Africa to a par total on the pitch at Buffalo Park. Shamilia Connell was the pick of the bowlers with 2 for 17 in her spell. Their batters let them down in the chase. Will West Indies Women show some fight against the Women in Blue or will India Women notch up another win in this series? Toss and team news coming up shortly. Stay tuned.

It is now time for the third game of the Women's T20I Tri-Series in South Africa as India Women take on West Indies Women at Buffalo Park in East London, South Africa. The two teams have already played a game and that has come against the hosts but both have had contrasting results. India Women were clinical against South Africa Women as they defended a par total with ease. After the failure of the top order, the lower order shone through with the likes of Amanjot Kaur and Deepti Sharma mustering up vital runs. The latter then carried the same form with the ball and picked up 3 wickets as well. The bowling overall was splendid and they will hope for more of the same. West Indies Women on the other hand didn't bowl badly at all but their batting was fairly sub-par as apart from skipper Hayley Matthews no one even looked like putting up a fight and they finished the 20 overs with just 97 runs on the board. The batting order is fairly inexperienced but they need to put up more of a fight if they are to beat an Indian side that has quality and depth in bowling as well. India Women will be in a commanding position with a win whereas West Indies Women can get on level terms with the two other sides by causing an upset. This one seems to be a fascinating encounter and we get to watch all the action. Who are you backing?
